item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Justin Sun says Tron’s post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
item.description: “We’re ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time,” Sun said in a post on X.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Tech chief says EU can fend off rogue AI risk: Report
item.description: There are global concerns following incidents at OpenAI ‌and Anthropic, and fears have arisen that rogue AI agents may venture beyond human control.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Sam Altman-backed Bitcoin life insurer, Meanwhile, raises more funds
item.description: The round follows increased international demand for Meanwhile’s Bitcoin life insurance policies amid broader macro instability.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: US plans to seize $1B in crypto linked to Iran this week: Scott Bessent
item.description: The Treasury Department has announced several digital asset seizures related to sanctions on Iran as part of US sanctions.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: New York permanently bars Celsius founder Mashinsky in $35M fraud settlement
item.description: The agreement resolves a 2023 civil fraud lawsuit against the Celsius founder and permanently bars him from the cryptocurrency, securities and commodities industries.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: THORChain exec accuses Tether of temporarily freezing USDT vaults
item.description: Chad Barraford, technical co-founder of the network, said that the funds were frozen and then unfrozen without explanation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: HSBC, Ant Digital test AI-agent payments using tokenized deposits
item.description: The technical trial showed how AI agents could discover services and make micropayments using HSBC’s tokenized deposits, with real-time settlement and risk checks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Ledger investigates fund losses linked to Southeast Asian reseller, warns users
item.description: Hardware wallet maker Ledger probes losses tied to reseller CryptoBilis, as researchers separately estimate more than $72 million to $86 million in suspected crypto thefts.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Blockchain.com pursues CFTC approval for prediction markets: CNBC
item.description: The crypto company has reportedly applied for two licenses with the US commodities regulatory as the courts weigh prediction markets cases.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Crypto Biz: Wealthy investors are buying crypto, but their advisers aren’t sold
item.description: Wealthy investors are embracing crypto faster than their advisers, while OKX attracts new funding and Strategy shifts more capital toward preferred stock buybacks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Bitcoin consolidates near $82.5K as crypto weathers Ledger theft reports
item.description: Bitcoin and crypto markets eyed a recovery from Thursday’s drop despite concerns of another hardware wallet exploit.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Dragonfly partner rejects ‘bunker mode’ doomerism, calls for proactive blockchain measures
item.description: Dragonfly’s Qureshi argued that asset migration is not a real solution in case of AI models breaking cryptographic signatures, and urged blockchains to adopt proactive measures.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: France is world’s most dangerous place for Bitcoiners: 90 attacks in 7 months
item.description: French authorities recorded 90 crypto-related cases involving kidnapping, extortion, threats and violent theft in seven months. What makes France such a hotspot?
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: ESMA seeks evidence tokenized collateral can be cashed out in crisis
item.description: ESMA is seeking industry feedback on the legal, liquidity and operational risks of tokenized collateral before deciding whether additional EU regulatory measures are necessary.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: UK sanctions three crypto exchanges tied to Russian illicit funds
item.description: The UK sanctioned crypto exchanges and payment processors, some of which were tied to thousands of Russian entities and the sanctioned HTX exchange.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: French lawmakers back stablecoin swap tax in 2027 budget bill
item.description: France’s Finance Committee backed taxes on stablecoin swaps, as well as unrealized crypto gains when households with more than 800,000 euros move abroad.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin speculators move 55K BTC to exchanges amid $1.1B liquidations
item.description: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000, sparking mass crypto liquidations as traders sent BTC to exchanges at a loss.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs’ October outflows swell toward $1B
item.description: Bitcoin ETFs lost $244 million on Thursday, while Ether funds extended their outflow streak to eight sessions, shedding $641 million.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Crypto projects apply for Anthropic’s new frontier AI security scanner
item.description: Anthropic’s new opt-in service promises vulnerability reports from its strongest AI models, including Claude Mythos.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Trump administration outlines quantum, AI initiatives in $6B science push
item.description: The White House outlined a $215 million quantum computing competition and $2.4 billion in AI industry commitments as concerns grow over quantum threats to cryptocurrency security.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Thailand finalizes rules paving way for Bitcoin, Ether ETFs
item.description: The rules are set to take effect next week, allowing crypto ETFs to trade exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Cantor Fitzgerald faces Senate Democrat’s questions over Tether ties
item.description: The letter follows a report by the Democratic investigators last month alleging Tether’s USDT has become a key tool for Iran’s shadow banking network.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: China’s P2P stablecoin wallets surge 43x, Korea’s $450B crypto economy: Asia Express
item.description: Despite ongoing bans, China has seen a big surge in peer-to-peer stablecoin use. New figures show South Korea’s $450B crypto economy is the largest in East Asia.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Securitize stock jumps over 10% after launching tokenized US equities on Solana
item.description: Securitize’s new offering gives eligible investors access to tokenized shares of 12 US companies, with dividend and voting rights and plans for round-the-clock trading.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: NFL backs New Jersey authorities in SCOTUS petition over Kalshi
item.description: According to the league, Kalshi and other prediction markets “threaten game integrity” because many event contracts are “highly susceptible to manipulation.”
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Netflix drops trailer for series based on FTX’s SBF and Caroline Ellison
item.description: Sam Bankman-Fried remains in federal prison following his 2023 conviction, while Caroline Ellison was released in January.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: IMF warns tokenized markets could amplify financial risks
item.description: The global financial institution found tokenized equity markets less liquid and more volatile than traditional markets, despite growing demand for 24/7 trading.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin nears 3-week low as oil heads higher on Iran strike woes
item.description: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000 and oil prices gained after reports that military confrontation between the US and Iran could return.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: US government moves $1B in seized Bitcoin after $770M transfers
item.description: Blockchain analysts identified the US government wallet tied to the recovery of funds from the Bitfinex hack.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright
